name: Amaoto to Nemu no Yoru
source:
The Night of Rain and Nemu is a short atmospheric visual novel about a lonely girl and a quiet rainy night.

One rainy evening, the protagonist returns home and finds Nemu waiting alone. Through small conversations and shared moments, the player gradually learns about her loneliness, dependence, and gentle warmth.

This is a short emotional story focused on atmosphere, quiet intimacy, and rainy-night feelings.

[From [url=https://tac777.itch.io/the-night-of-rain-and-nemu]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《雨夜与涅姆》是一部短篇大气视觉小说，讲述了一个孤独的女孩和一个安静的雨夜。

一个雨夜，主人公回到家，发现涅姆独自在等。通过小小的对话和分享的时刻，玩家逐渐了解她的孤独、依赖和温柔的温暖。

这是一个简短的情感故事，重点关注氛围、安静的亲密和雨夜的感受。

[来自[url=https://tac777.itch.io/the-night-of-rain-and-nemu]itch.io[/url]]
